result: Implemented a structured outcome ledger, calibration metric, CLI reporting, persistence, and tests.
Implemented a conservative GitHub Issues bridge with deterministic ownership markers, dry-run by default, explicit apply mode, unmanaged-issue protection, tests, and safety documentation.
Implemented an optional provider-neutral OpenAI-compatible planning adapter with deterministic fallback, backlog-ID validation, local-model support, CLI integration, tests, and safety documentation.

Implemented an explicit-allowlist subprocess containment layer with isolated temporary working directories, minimal environments, timeout enforcement, bounded output capture, structured results, CLI integration, tests, and an explicit threat model that does not overclaim OS isolation.

Implemented deterministic dry-run-first backlog replenishment with pending-work blocking, stable curated candidate IDs, duplicate protection, schema validation, explicit apply mode, tests, and operating documentation.

Implemented a deterministic residual-based planner calibration checkpoint with sample-size gating, signed-bias classification, CLI reporting, tests, and documentation. The first five outcomes show systematic underprediction, so relative planner weights remain unchanged pending feature-level evidence.

Implemented a deterministic journal synthesis snapshot with evidence provenance, repeated lesson signals, ranked missing capabilities, preview-by-default CLI behavior, explicit write mode, tests, and documentation while preserving the append-only journal.

Implemented deterministic named sandbox capability manifests with shared bare-executable allowlist validation, deterministic audit listing, manifest/manual conflict rejection, bounded execution policy, tests, and documentation without claiming an OS security boundary.
